title: Download scoped all-matching order sales currency summaries as Excel
description: A user downloads the currently filtered all-matching approved order sales currency summary as Excel from the existing order-profit designer. Add a summary/export endpoint that independently validates/rechecks identity/menu/fresh scope and invokes the same server-derived summary from ERP-224; the request must not trust client rows or require a prior preview. Workbook has stable original-currency/count/signed known sales rows and explicit unknown currency/null amount, with normalized dates/customer/currency and all-matching/source-cap/unknown-cost context. Use existing ExcelExporter/NPOI helpers for formula-safe labels, numeric counts/known amounts and unknown cells distinct from zero. No cross-currency grand total, cost/current-price/profit sums or conversion. Designer retains form state, sends current filters and clearly distinguishes this summary download from selected-page detail Excel. Existing detail Excel/PDF remain compatible. Development only: reuse existing order-profit menu, fresh current-user SalespersonDataScopeService, approved nondeleted scoped SalesOrders and existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit. Do not accept client identity/scope/rows/aggregates as authority or widen ERP permissions. No arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct table/business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, migrations, production SQL or real database execution, secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible actions, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated work. Run focused in-memory API/service/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test. Any unavailable external environment acceptance must be explicitly environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Summary Excel independently revalidates current dates/filters and reauthorizes current ERP identity/menu/scope, reusing all-matching server summary and returning no file on revoked permission/invalid input/cap overflow.

Workbook preserves stable currency rows, numeric counts/known amounts, explicit unknown/null cells and formula-safe text plus normalized filter/date/source-cap/all-matching context without cross-currency or profit totals.
Designer summary download sends current filters and preserves form/error states; workbook/API/UI tests plus existing detail export regressions and safe Release build/test pass.
